label: D1 in the last ~10 trials of the episode, after no reward, when the agent is about to switch from a2 to a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (it never fires at GO or D2), and almost only in episode trials 90-99 (96% of mass; 80-89 has the rest, never before trial 80). It also tracks low model value (98% of mass where value < 5.22). On its own, late-episode D1 has F1 0.04: it covers 96% of the mass but has 2% precision. Within that window it is enriched when the previous trial was unrewarded (88% of mass), when the previous choice was a2, and when the upcoming choice is a switch to a1 (the D1 policy logit leans toward a1). The strongest activations are a1 choices made after a run of unrewarded a2 trials. The recorded predicate (late D1 & prev unrewarded & about to switch to a1) gets dev F1 0.42 (precision 0.46, mass recall 0.54). It uses action/stay at D1, which are marked FUTURE, but they are the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes, not a random outcome. The closest observed-only version, late D1 & prev unrewarded & prev a2 & choice logit > 0, scores lower (F1 about 0.27). Many activations are weak, and many late, unrewarded D1 steps stay silent, so this explanation is incomplete.
